source_claim: In an official Cosmic Princess Kaguya! production interview, director Shingo Yamashita discusses Iroha’s mother Momiji as a character in the anime and novelization, describing her role and the phone scene between her and Iroha.
notes: The official film news site interviews the director and novelist about the Sakayori family. The director explicitly identifies Momiji as Iroha’s mother and discusses her anime/novelization scenes, establishing this campaign character in the work.
